name: 04-pixel-monster-v2
prompt: Create a single original friendly fantasy creature as crisp retro 16-bit game PIXEL ART, shown large on a plain pale ivory background. A little cobalt-blue rock dragon with a chunky rounded head, bright amber eyes, small golden crystal horns, cream belly and a thick curled tail with golden crystal plates. Sturdy short legs and small clawed arms, confident cheerful standing three-quarter pose, whole body and tail in frame. A cream chest medallion has a clear dark pixel letter S. Strong readable creature silhouette and saturated blue and gold colors. Deliberately visible square pixels, stepped dark navy outline, clean pixel clusters and a limited palette, like a native 96-pixel sprite enlarged by nearest neighbor. No smooth painted contours, no blur, no soft gradients, no 3D rendering. One character only, generous margins, no interface, no extra writing or logos. Appealing collectible companion for a young child's phonics adventure.

name: 05-brick-explorer-v2
prompt: A single full-body original cheerful brick-built explorer toy hero in a studio product photograph, a design revision emphasizing LEGO-like BUILDABLE BRICK TOY construction, not generic smooth vinyl mascot. Golden-yellow explorer helmet made of visible interlocking small bricks with four exposed cylindrical studs on top and a short stepped brim. Oversized cream cuboid smiling head, mint-green rectangular torso assembled from visibly separate brick plates, orange shoulder bricks with exposed round studs, ivory inset chest tile with bold dark uppercase S. Dark teal hinge joints, cream C-shaped gripping hands with circular grip openings, short navy rectangular legs with explicit hip hinges, orange block boots with visible round connection studs on toes, orange backpack made of two stacked bricks. A few genuine-looking open connector holes on side surfaces. All pieces plausibly connect, unmistakable stud-and-tube brick design language. Keep the friendly block explorer identity, broad head and short limbs. Both feet grounded, one arm slightly lifted in ready pose. Real glossy injection-molded ABS, crisp manufactured edges, subtle rounded corners, realistic studio reflections and soft floor shadow. Warm ivory background, full body three-quarter front view and generous margins. No drawn outlines, no cel shading, no brand logo, no other text, no scenery, no extra characters. Child-friendly collectible toy portrait.

name: 06-career-heroes-v2
prompt: Create a beautifully finished Korean WEBTOON-style character lineup concept sheet for a five-year-old child's phonics adventure game. SIX different friendly adult professional heroes, full body, in a clean 3-column by 2-row grid, every cell equally sized with generous space. Top row: astronaut in white/orange space suit with clear bubble helmet held by side; firefighter in vivid yellow protective turnout coat with reflective silver stripes, red helmet and coiled hose; police officer in neat navy uniform, peaked cap, radio and friendly open-hand greeting. Bottom row: fighter pilot in olive flight suit with aviation helmet under arm and oxygen hose, no plane; soldier in green field uniform and cap with utility backpack and boots, no firearm; navy officer in smart white naval uniform and white peaked cap with dark brim. Six clearly DIFFERENT faces and hairstyles, competent warm expressions. Attractive heroic adult proportions, slightly broad shoulders, strong but not exaggerated physiques, relaxed confident standing poses with both feet grounded. Every character has a clearly legible cream S badge integrated on chest, no other text or rank insignia. Strong bright KOREAN COLOR WEBTOON visual language: clean expressive ink linework, polished cel shading with selective smooth digital shadow accents, appealing simplified faces, vivid confident colors. NOT photorealistic, NOT plastic toys, NOT pixel art, NOT western halftone comic, NOT chibi. Clear recognizable professional uniforms and role-specific equipment, no weapons or threatening gestures. Plain warm off-white background and minimal contact shadows. All heads, feet and gear fully visible, no cropping, no labels, no panels or speech bubbles. Landscape sheet with six characters.
